CONTRACTS & POLICIES

Market your grain from a position of strength

At Farmers Cooperative, we believe surprises are not a good thing when it comes to grain marketing. That's why we get to know you and your business objectives to provide consistent risk management programs that meet and exceed your expectations.

Our mission, "Investing in Our Owners' Success," drives us to continually update our facilities and increase our storage capacity. Rest assured, you'll have speed and space when you need it most for grain delivery.

We also bring competitive price advantages to our owners through our ability to arbitrage in competitive markets, including exports, domestic and local processors. And the knowledge and experience of our origination staff allows you to confidently make tough decisions when marketing your grain.

Whether it's service, facilities, products or markets, Farmers Cooperative is committed to providing you with a full support system from the farm to the market.

Faster dump times for wider variety of crops.
Our financial strength allows us to invest in modern facilities and better serve the needs of our member owners.

Introducing the NEW Farmers Cooperative Portal
A simpler, more connected way to manage your business. Access your account anytime, anywhere - from your phone, tablet, or computer.

With the Customer Portal, you can:

  • View grain cash bids and settlements in real-time
  • Access and download invoices, contracts, tickets, and statements
  • Easily pay invoices and manage banking info
  • eSign contracts quickly and securely
  • Track purchase history and product details
  • Manage bookings, prepays, and more
  • Seamlessly communicate with our team
